information.purpose: Group related facts in one pane while leaving reading paragraphs in the content stack.

textContent.purpose: Place a view's text item as reading content in the stack.

accessGate.purpose: Hold the product behind access: show the access screen until a session is ready, then the view product.

accessScreen.purpose: Sign a person in to the product through the access experience, with the remembered profile and appearance.

appearance.purpose: Choose the interface appearance and see whether the choice could be kept.

appearancePreferences.purpose: Choose mode, text size, tint and a system wallpaper with immediate local preview.

appearancePreview.purpose: Compare Dark and Light using the same surface, tint and wallpaper tokens as the running interface.

avatarShuffle.purpose: Generate a new avatar seed on activation and reveal the shuffle overlay on hover or focus.

identity.purpose: Show the signed-in identity's display name, identity name and role, or say that identity access is not installed.
identity.notInstalled: Human identity access is not installed in this developer session.

lockScreen.purpose: Unlock the selected identity while its private content stays hidden.

inspection.purpose: Browse the local inspection catalog and open one of its records as a detail, without product commands.

inspectionCatalog.title: Component bank
inspectionCatalog.subtitle: Interactive examples. Changes stay here; no product commands are executed.

sharedOwnerSpecimen.openFact: Open the Fact component from the index to inspect every declared state.
sharedOwnerSpecimen.openButton: Open the Button component from the index.
sharedOwnerSpecimen.attention: Requires attention. The same amber indicator appears in Home and every presentation of the object. Reduced motion keeps it steady.

specimen.purpose: Witness one resolved node in one scenario, with local interaction, through the product node and frame grammar.

specimenGroup.purpose: Group the bank examples of one resolved node kind under a state chooser and its contract inspection.

specimenGroup.offline: Offline. Existing reading and local drafts are retained; controller-dependent choices and commits are unavailable until reconnection.

specimenRow.purpose: Witness one fixture state of a bank entry inside its own heading scope, shown only while the state chooser names it.

specimenUnavailable.purpose: Explain in place of a bank specimen why it cannot be executed here.

specimenUnavailable.title: Execution adapter required

contractInspection.purpose: Read the declared contract, coverage gaps and evidence of one resolved node kind.

controlBench.purpose: Exercise every control specimen locally in the bank, reporting each interaction without any product command.

mediaReferenceSpecimen.purpose: Witness the media reference selector in the bank with one local image and local state.

referenceSpecimen.purpose: Exercise one labels or reference owner in the bank with local example values and no product command.

inspectionContent.purpose: Mount the visual catalog inspection and reveal one of its entries for a caller that binds it.

publicCatalogBank.purpose: Show the component bank in the workspace and let the workspace reveal and focus one of its entries.

publicCatalogBankSpecimen.pressed: Diagnostic action pressed. No domain effect or acceptance.

facts.purpose: Read a labeled value, including the difference between an empty value and an unknown value.

mediaGrid.purpose: Browse a media collection as artwork tiles or list rows and open one item.

mediaCollectionGrid.purpose: Show media collections as a grid of covers with title and item count, and open the one the person picks.

mediaObject.purpose: Show the media fact of an object's context: playable audio or video, an image, or a placeholder when unavailable.

library.purpose: Browse a media library by album and open its items in the viewer, returning focus to the opener.

catalogDetail.purpose: Read one catalog item with its media and details in the current destination.

mediaContent.purpose: Mount a view's media library at its open album and reveal a record in it on request.

catalogNavigation.purpose: Retired: the shell draws the navigation pane from the workspace's destinations.

contentFlow.purpose: Arrange reading, overview or gallery stacks within the shared content measures and responsive layout.

viewContent.purpose: Draw one resolved view as a content flow and let the workspace reveal its bank entries and media records.

viewItem.purpose: Mount the piece for one view item's kind (text, fact, destination link, bound node or summary widget).

viewBinding.purpose: Show one view item's node: its own control, its collection's summary, its bound node or the message of a pending input.

viewWorkspace.purpose: Present a view program as a workspace with navigation, search, retained views and its panel.

viewProduct.purpose: Mount a view program's product: its browser session and workspace, against the human surface and its input validator.

workspace.purpose: Mount the workspace of a view program with its resolved view, panel, error and events.

publicCatalogProduct.purpose: Mount the public catalog product content for the built public catalog page.

localExercises.purpose: Draw the public catalog's local exercises and raise their node events toward the catalog.

controlRenderer.purpose: Mount the piece for one control node and forward only its control events.

catalogCard.purpose: Open a media item from a card composed of artwork and its supporting content.

review.purpose: Inspect the prepared result before accepting a change or recovering an uncertain result.

objectStateControl.purpose: Choose an object state through a contextual command; a retained selection is not a required form input.

selectControl.purpose: Choose one value from a labeled field and a shared options popover.

popoverControl.purpose: Read contextual information in a temporary surface anchored to its trigger.

fileControl.purpose: Select supported local files and inspect their limits before an operation uses them.

speedDial.purpose: Reveal overflowing contextual commands beside their readable labels, without putting content navigation in the toolbar.

moneyControl.scale: Enter an amount with up to {scale} decimal places.
moneyControl.currencyScale: Enter an amount representable in {currency} with up to {scale} decimal places before changing currency.

labelsControl.purpose: Compose the field well, value rail and options from the same shared owners as every labels control.
labelsControl.label: Label

referenceSelector.purpose: Choose referenced objects through a labeled field and the shared selection popover.
referenceSelector.name: Name

mediaReferenceSelector.purpose: Select media references from a shared field without introducing another media library or creation path.

relatedSelection.purpose: Edit related objects within the current context using shared choices and explicit local feedback.

toolbar.purpose: Show a surface's toolbar commands (title, navigation, actions) and invoke the intent of the one pressed.

utilityActions.purpose: Stack a frame's utility actions as secondary actions and pass the pressed one's intent to the host.

dialog.purpose: Ask for an explicit answer, or explain a warning or error, in a compact centred message with clear primary and secondary actions.

problem.purpose: Explain a warning or error in a modal message the person dismisses unless it is locked.

viewPanel.purpose: Present a view's resolved panel as a confirmation dialog or a drawer, reporting its events as node events.

surfaceSpecimen.purpose: Demonstrate a mounted surface, the transient it launches, and the rules of surface composition.
surfaceSpecimen.mountedSubtitle: Content and toolbars; no lateral child surfaces.
surfaceSpecimen.mountedText: This transient belongs to the launching surface. Close returns focus to its command.
surfaceSpecimen.exampleSubtitle: The same toolbar and content owners used by every mounted surface.
surfaceSpecimen.rulesMounted: The main surface owns content and its docking areas. Top and bottom accept only toolbars; left and right accept surfaces. A mounted surface owns content and toolbars, never another left or right surface.
surfaceSpecimen.rulesAuthoring: Current authoring admits a left navigation surface; the runtime may dock an object context on the right when space allows. Arbitrary right-dock View composition is not installed.

stack.purpose: Draw one titled stack of a place's items, each through the node renderer.

placeContent.purpose: Show a place's checked content: its header and each of its stacks.

placeHeader.purpose: Head a place's content with its title, its subtitle and an optional background image, never a toolbar.

localExerciseContent.purpose: Present the local exercises place as a draft its own events reduce, forwarding catalog navigation to the host.

failureDialog.purpose: Explain a failed command in a problem dialog derived from its failure code, saying when the outcome is uncertain.

frameBody.purpose: Render the body of a surface frame by its content kind and route its events to the frame.

instanceFrame.purpose: Draw the transient frame of one mounted instance, keeping its callbacks through teardown.

panel.purpose: Keep an owned view panel mounted across open and close, routing its events with the owner it was mounted for.

confirmationDialog.purpose: Ask for explicit confirmation in a compact temporary surface with clear primary and secondary actions.

bar.purpose: Keep navigation and contextual commands in the surface toolbar; reveal its title and subtitle only after the content header scrolls away.
bar.settingsUnavailable: Settings — not available in this preview

mediaViewer.purpose: Show images, audio and video full screen with paging, zoom and playback, and return focus to what opened them.
mediaViewer.instructions: Swipe or use arrows to change media. Pinch, double-click or use plus and minus to zoom images. Space plays or pauses audio and video. Escape closes the viewer.

attentionIndicator.purpose: Mark objects needing attention with the same amber indicator everywhere, steady when reduced motion is enabled.
attentionIndicator.label: Requires attention

choice.purpose: Choose one or several options given as data, as rows, cards, swatches or a menu, with a persistent label.

dateControl.purpose: Choose one day from a month calendar opened from a labelled field well, within optional bounds.

factValue.purpose: Read one scalar fact as text, or show that it is unknown or empty with a muted icon and an accessible state.

factRow.purpose: Keep a capitalized label on the left and its value or its control right-aligned, with shared horizontal dividers and balanced wrapping.

field.purpose: Write a single line or several, or open a choice, in one labelled well with field help and validation feedback.
field.invalidNumber: Enter a number with up to {scale} decimal places using this field's format.

files.purpose: Select supported local files and inspect their limits before an operation uses them.
files.limits: Up to {count} files · {file} each · {total} total. Choosing files does not upload them.

gallery.purpose: Page through a set of photos in place, inline, heading a place or as a detail's photograph, and open them in the viewer.

heading.purpose: A title whose meaning picks its type role and level: display, page, section or field group.

image.purpose: Show a public or private image at the rendition its frame needs, hidden until decoded, with a fallback and optional retry, or the placeholder of missing artwork.

mediaPlayer.purpose: Play a video or audio item with its transport, seek and volume controls, showing artwork for audio and a retry when unavailable.

modal.purpose: Present a temporary surface over its parent, dismissed by Escape, its scrim or its grip unless locked.
modal.description: Close to return. Unsaved writing stays in this session.

shell.purpose: Host a workspace place with its navigation sidebar, toolbars, search overlay, panels and failure dialog.

themePreview.purpose: Compare Dark and Light using the same surface, tint and wallpaper tokens as the running interface.

attentionFeed.unavailable: Attention is unavailable. Last loaded items are read-only until reconnected.

systemStatus.noOperations: No operations are exposed to this surface.

connectionPresentation.unlock: Unlock your identity to reconnect to the controller.
connectionPresentation.incompatible: This controller requires a compatible surface version.
connectionPresentation.unavailable: Controller unavailable. Reconnect to use this action.

action.purpose: Invoke one command with a text button or an icon button, never competing text and icons.

appearanceRoot.purpose: Apply the chosen appearance to the whole page and publish the system colour scheme.

availability.purpose: Understand whether a capability is ready, unavailable or not yet known.

avatar.purpose: Show a person or identity as a seeded drawing, a picture or initials, optionally as the button that shuffles its seed.

card.purpose: Open one item, media, collection or summary from a card composed of artwork and its supporting content.

clock.purpose: Show today's date and the current time, kept current while shown.

colorBullet.purpose: Show a label’s color alongside its text without using color as its only meaning.

column.purpose: Stack pieces vertically with a gap from the spacing scale, at the reading, narrow or wide measure, aligned or centred.

face.purpose: A round decorative mark that identifies a title or an option by icon, document, status, symbol or flag.

form.purpose: Submit a labelled group of fields together, from any of its fields or its submit action.

grid.purpose: Lay pieces out in auto-fitted tracks of one recipe (tiles, collections, cards, covers, results) with a gap from the spacing scale.

icon.purpose: Draw one named glyph of the product's icon set, optionally toned, sized to the text or placed inside a control.

inline.purpose: Lay pieces out in a horizontal sequence with a gap from the spacing scale: wrapping, in a labelled scroll rail, or neither.

list.purpose: Hold sibling rows or facts in one shared pane, at the reading measure or the full overview width.

loading.purpose: Show that content is on its way, as skeleton lines or a spinner, and announce it by its label.

menu.purpose: Reveal overflowing contextual commands beside their readable labels, without putting content navigation in the toolbar.

meter.purpose: Show a total split into labelled segments: the total, a bar proportional to each segment and the legend.

placeHeading.purpose: Head a place, or content embedded in one, with its title, subtitle and optional featured media.

popover.purpose: Open contextual content, a form, options or commands in a surface anchored to its trigger.

row.purpose: Open one object or destination from a list row, or read one, and say why an unavailable one cannot open.

separator.purpose: Draw a hairline in the separator ink between the pieces of a column or a row, optionally inset like grouped rows.

slider.purpose: Set one bounded value along a track, such as a playback position or a volume.

spacer.purpose: Leave an empty space of one spacing step, or take the space a row or column leaves over.

stackItem.purpose: Place one entry of a stack at the content or the surface inset.

stackLayout.purpose: Group related content under one title, with an optional description and required mark.

status.purpose: Say why there is nothing to show (empty, offline, a note) and what to do next, as a block or a compact caption.

surface.purpose: Arrange content and top or bottom toolbars, with lateral surfaces only at the root. Mounted surfaces keep their own content and toolbars.

tag.purpose: Show one label as a toned chip, removable when its owner allows, or a reference as its name beside its color.

text.purpose: A paragraph of plain text in a type role and tone, optionally announced as a status or inset to align with rows.

viewRegion.purpose: Frame one view's content, one of its items, a place's document or a retained place with the identity navigation reveals; bare renders content unframed.

wallpaper.purpose: Provide system-generated Silk, Mist or Plain backgrounds that follow the selected appearance.
